description: Capitalization rate of a property: yearly NOI divided by the purchase price, as a ratio and a percent, with the most to pay for a target cap rate and the monthly rent-to-price ratio when those inputs are sent. A cap rate is only as good as its NOI: a monthly figure sent as yearly, or NOI after the mortgage, gives a number that looks plausible and is wrong by a factor of twelve or more, so the answer flags a cap rate over 25% and rent over 3% of price. Send noi (per year, may be negative) and price; optionally target_cap_pct and monthly_rent. A price of 0 is refused by name.

monthly_rent.description: Scheduled rent per month, e.g. 3200, for the rent-to-price ratio

noi.description: Net operating income per year, in dollars, e.g. 28000

target_cap_pct.description: Target cap rate in percent, e.g. 8, for the most to pay at that rate

name: compute_cap_rate
title: Cap rate
